title: Isopiestic Measurements on the System Water-Sodium Chloride-Magnesium Chloride at 25 deg
experimental_method: Isopiestic method at 25 C: seven solutions (pure NaCl, pure MgCl2 and mixtures) equilibrated per run for 3-7 days; concentrations by weighing dried salts, adding water and reweighing after equilibration; MgCl2.6H2O water corrected, weights in vacuo; saturated NaCl taken as 6.1443 m.
uncertainties_stated: Uncertainty of log gamma about +/-0.004 (McKay-Perring); standard deviation of phi(obs)-phi(calc) 0.002; isopiestic osmotic coefficients agree with Robinson and Stokes within 0.5%.
quality_remarks: Two printed values are obviously misprinted: set 7 R = 0.1062 (should be near 1.06) and set 17 I = 0.7676 (should be near 7.77); kept as printed. Temperature scale not stated. The first PDF page begins with the end of another article (Harned rule discussion, p. 4053) which is not this paper; Tables II and III belong to this paper.
not_extracted_tables: Table II: mean activity coefficients (log gamma for NaCl and MgCl2, McKay-Perring and Scatchard treatments, plus literature emf values) - derived
Table III: Harned's rule coefficients - derived
